products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and operates across several product lines aimed at clinical care, research, imaging, and population health.

Its portfolio includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution providing point-of-care insights for clinicians; Zelta, a cloud-based platform for clinical data management and acquisition used in clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, which includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo receiving a 2025 Best in KLAS ranking. The company also offers Truven, which provides health data, analytics, and consulting services, as well as a portfolio focused on real-world evidence studies.

The held facts classify Merative under healthcare and life sciences AI, noting its work in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
